subject: One useful question before the next bed or mattress trial
preheader: Use the 2pm versus 2am test to keep the trial focused on the decision.
intro: You may have come across Sleep Choice through an earlier email, conversation or professional event.
The simplest way to explain our approach is the difference between how equipment appears at 2pm and what it needs to support at 2am.
sectionTitle: Make the trial answer a real question
body: A bed or mattress can look suitable during a daytime assessment and still leave important questions unanswered through ordinary overnight use.
Defining those questions first gives the trial a clearer purpose and gives the OT more useful observations to bring back into the equipment decision.
questions: What overnight task or concern needs to be understood?
What should be observed during ordinary use at home?
Which configuration variables need to be compared?
What evidence would help support the next decision?
actionTitle: Bring us the question, not a product code
actionText: Sleep Choice can help configure and coordinate an in-home bed or mattress trial around the question you are trying to resolve. Send us the person, their goals, the current setup and the equipment decision you need to make.
teamName: The Sleep Choice x Supply Ministry Team
trialFooterText: Seven-night in-home trial availability, service area, equipment configuration and individual arrangements are confirmed per case.
